summary: Automation content navigator subcommands are collections, config, doc, images, inventory, replay (explore a previous run from an artifact), run and welcome; each accepts the related Ansible CLI options, and ansible-navigator <command> --help shows details.
questions: Which ansible-navigator command replays a playbook artifact?

answer_card.title: ansible-navigator commands
answer_card.answer_md:
| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `collections` | Explore available collections |
| `config` | Explore the current Ansible configuration |
| `doc` | Review documentation for a module or plugin |
| `images` | Explore execution environment images |
| `inventory` | Explore an inventory |
| `replay` | Explore a previous run using a playbook artifact |
| `run` | Run a playbook |
| `welcome` | Start at the welcome page |

Use `ansible-navigator <command> --help` for options.
